intro: Exchange rate tracking app, with clear and interactive visualization of currency fluctuations.
text: FX Checker is a web application for tracking and comparing exchange rates in real time. The project emphasizes data clarity with interactive charts, a minimalist interface and a smooth user experience. Built with React and Recharts, it offers dynamic visualization of currency fluctuations, along with a comparison tool and a history feature. Fully responsive and optimized for quick reading of financial data.
